title: Card imagery with license manifest and credits
description: Wave 2, after content (needs card ids). Area: public/cards/ (images), src/features/game-content/ image manifest, and a credits screen. A subagent sources one fitting image per card: Openverse or Wikimedia Commons (CC0/CC-BY) first, then Unsplash/Pexels under their API terms (credit, hotlinking and download tracking). Reject recognizable people or brands and unclear licenses. Manifest per image: card id, source URL, author, license, required credit text. Crop consistently for the card frame; responsive sizes, modern formats (AVIF/WebP), lazy loading. Credits shown in the game. Any API key is fetched server-side or at build time, never in code; ask the owner with a sign-up link and env var name. Size M.

title: Game feel: asymmetric juice and animations
description: Rules SSOT: documentation/DOC_GAME_DESIGN.md. Vision: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md (Dutch, phone-first, no accounts). Wave 3, after the game board. Area: src/features/game-juice/ (new) plus motion tokens. The design's asymmetric feedback: viral = screen shake, neon confetti, emoji burst, pulsing counter; ad = coins fly to the Inkomsten meter, slot-machine count-up, gold glow; news = dry slide, small shield at Reputatie, no particles. Card draw/play, gains/losses, win/loss animations. Full prefers-reduced-motion support (and the settings toggle when it exists). Size M.

title: Settings, error states and launch audit
description: Wave 3. Area: src/features/game-settings/ (new) and error/empty states. Settings screen (motion, reset progress; sound once audio exists), offline/failed-to-load/unsupported states with retry and home. Launch audit: WCAG AA and keyboard play across all screens, mobile performance and bundle budget, CI green, production deploy verified. Size S.

title: Show wasted gains at the meter cap
description: Found by the balance lap: when a meter is at 100, positive effects on that meter are wasted but the card still shows +N, so players don't learn to adapt. Show a MAX/greyed gain on card effects that would push a meter past 100 (and maybe a subtle cap glow on the meter). Area: src/features/game-board/ (+ GameCard prop if needed). Fits with the game-feel lap. Size S.

title: Users stat derived from the meter
description: Balance lap proposal (option A): today stats.users accumulates meter deltas x usersPerPoint per phase (engine D1), so it can hit 0 while the Gebruikers meter is mid-range and one event can remove millions. Derive the users stat from the meter instead (e.g. phase floor x growth^meter) and re-tune the 100k/5M/20M goals. Touches src/features/game-engine/ (D1), game-content balance and board goal copy. Size M.

title: Proposed: Tutorial and how-to-play
description: Interactive first-game walkthrough plus a how-to-play help screen. Value: new players understand the three meters and the hidden toxicity within the first minute. Size M. Fits the vision (anyone online, no teacher). Owner ranks at Stop 1; do not build without go-ahead.

title: Proposed: Share card with score
description: Share button on the results screen: a generated share image with the outcome and score plus the link. Value: spreads the game. Size S. Owner ranks at Stop 1; do not build without go-ahead.

title: Proposed: Local save and resume
description: Save the running game and stats in the browser (localStorage) so a refresh doesn't lose a run. Value: fewer lost games on phones. Size S. No accounts needed. Owner ranks at Stop 1; do not build without go-ahead.

title: Proposed: Achievements and unlockable cards
description: Local achievements (for example: IPO reached, game over by each cause, a run without news) and cards unlocked by them. Value: replay. Size M. Daily challenges and streaks are a later lap. Owner ranks at Stop 1; do not build without go-ahead.

title: Proposed: Launch basics: privacy note and SEO
description: A short privacy note (no accounts, no tracking unless analytics is added), robots and a sitemap. Favicon, icons and share tags already exist. Value: trust and findability. Size XS. Owner ranks at Stop 1; do not build without go-ahead.

title: Proposed: Performance budget in CI
description: Bundle size limit and a mobile Lighthouse check so the first load stays fast on phones. Value: keeps the game quick as content and images grow. Size S. Owner ranks at Stop 1; do not build without go-ahead.

title: Proposed: Privacy-friendly analytics and error reporting
description: See where players drop off (which phase, which game over) and catch runtime errors. Needs an external service or the parked Supabase setup: stop-list item, ask the owner before choosing. Size S. Owner ranks at Stop 1; do not build without go-ahead.

title: Proposed: Leaderboard
description: Global high scores. Needs Supabase (parked) and a privacy check (nicknames, moderation). Value: competition. Size M. Stop-list item (data, external service). Owner ranks at Stop 1; do not build without go-ahead.

title: Proposed: English language option
description: Language switch Dutch/English. The vision says Dutch only, so this conflicts with a recorded decision; every content item doubles. Size M. Owner ranks at Stop 1; do not build without go-ahead.

title: Configure Supabase
description: Parked by the owner (onboarding): Supabase code stays, setup later. The game runs in the browser without accounts (vision); set this up when crash logging, player feedback or a global high-score list is wanted. Set up the backend: one Supabase project with the auth providers you use enabled, its Site URL set to the app's primary origin, and its URL and publishable key available as VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (local .env, plus the hosting build variables for main and for previews). Before the app has real users, isolate staging from production with a Supabase Branching staging branch or a second project (documentation/DOC_CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS.md § Staging backend). Your coding agent lists the exact requirements, checks the result, and tells you what only you can do. For Google sign-in, requirements are in documentation/DOC_SUPABASE_GOOGLE_OAUTH.md. If you explicitly say this app does not use Supabase, Google sign-in, anonymous sessions, or error reporting, the agent offers to delete that code. Agent gate: .agents/skills/loop-backlog/references/onboarding.md § Shipped integrations and § Configuration tasks gate (Supabase).

title: In-app feedback widget
description: A small signed-in feedback form that writes to app_feedback with the page and environment. Depends on: Signals backend task.

title: Admin signals view and switch the signal adapter on
description: An admin-only view (role claim) to triage error clusters and feedback, and turn on loop-backlog's signal adapter so open signals become ranked backlog tasks. Depends on: Signals backend, error capture and feedback widget tasks.

title: Add a db:push-staging script or fix the adapter reference
description: The signal adapter (.agents/skills/loop-backlog/references/signal-adapter.md) tells the agent to run `pnpm run db:push-staging`, which does not exist. Either add a script that applies supabase/migrations to the staging project with a pinned Supabase CLI (needs project linking, which the owner must set up), or change the adapter to say the connector or CLI applies migrations. Protected file edit: needs owner approval. Context: documentation/DOC_DECISION_LOG.md § signals-backend D8.

title: Decide whether the app uses anonymous sign-ins
description: The app asks Supabase for an anonymous session on every visit and Supabase refuses (anonymous_provider_disabled, HTTP 422), twice per page load. Either enable anonymous sign-ins in the project (anonymous users get the authenticated role, so the feedback policy would admit them; review RLS first) or remove the call. Auth permission model: needs an owner decision.

title: Path-scope src-only guidance into its own rule
description: Context-cost audit follow-up (R10): move src-only guidance (architecture code placement and edge-case placement, code-style TypeScript and styling, debugging API troubleshooting) out of always-on rules into a rule with paths: ["src/**"], saving about 1.7k tokens on non-src tasks. Keep the folder meanings in architecture.md § Folder structure. Protected files: owner consent per edit.

title: Trim skill descriptions with trigger tests
description: Context-cost audit follow-up (R11): shorten the .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md descriptions that are listed in every session (about 3.5k tokens; target about -0.8k) and verify with meta-write-skill trigger tests that the right skill still triggers. Protected files: owner consent.

title: Let loop skills call Claude Code built-in review skills
description: Context-cost audit follow-up (R12): have loop-check call the built-in /code-review and loop-build or spec-optimize-performance call /simplify instead of duplicating their checks; /loop and /batch do not overlap loop-orchestrate. Protected files: owner consent.

title: Port feedback hooks to Cursor
description: Feedback-hooks follow-up: check the current Cursor hooks docs (afterFileEdit, stop) and port the Claude Code PostToolUse lint/format hook and Stop type-check hook where Cursor supports equivalent behavior; document gaps.

description: Process gap found when the owner asked how far threads followed the loop skills (2026-11-04): landed laps left documentation/jobs/temp_job_* folders on main (game-engine, game-card, game-content, game-audio, game-board, game-flow, installable-app + template leftovers feedback-hooks, orchestrator-parallel-laps), and only game-engine has a section in documentation/DOC_DECISION_LOG.md.
